To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

text mining tools have the potential to improve efficiency and accuracy of annotation tasks, but that the usability of the tool is a critical factor in determining the utility of the tool for biocuration.

the text mining systems tested in this study were able to improve the efficiency of biocuration tasks, and the biocuratorial expertise of the end user is an important factor in the success of the text mining system.
In summary, our research is concerned with
understanding the utility of text mining for biocuration and the usability of text mining systems by biocurators.
the development and application of text-mining tools for biocuration.
the development and testing of text mining systems that can assist biocurators.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the text mining systems that participated in the task were able to improve curation efficiency and in some cases, curation accuracy as well.
the BioCreative IV Track 3: Interactive Text Mining Task is the first step toward a systematic study of the utility and usability for text mining tools.
the text mining systems that were evaluated in this task are useful for assisting in biocuration tasks, but that there is room for improvement.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the systems were able, in most cases, to improve efficiency, but that the systems’ ability to improve accuracy varied depending on the system, the curation task and the biocurator’s expertise.
the systems were able not only to improve the efficiency and the annotation accuracy but also to provide the curation teams with a new perspective on their work and to help them to improve it.
the systems that performed best in this track were those that were designed to support a specific curation task.
The main takeaway from our work is that

there is a need for more interaction and communication among text mining tool developers, biocurators and database developers to ensure that the systems being developed are useful and usable in the context of the curation workflow.
the development of a tool is not sufficient for it to be used in practice.
the curation task should be considered as an integral part of the evaluation of text mining tools.
